_example.status: ROUTE_ON_MAIN (deliveries from stored stops and deliveries; debt from closed days; schedule from the stored plans)
_example.basis: need: REAL Census 2011 reweighted (DERIVED, HISTORICAL) + A2; bookings: REAL HMWSSB section records placed on wards (DERIVED_APPROXIMATE); deliveries: REAL or SYNTHETIC as the stops are registered; debt: DERIVED (A6 from closed days); schedule: the plan's own basis. Each live block is {value, basis, reason}: value null with basis UNAVAILABLE and the reason when there is nothing yet.
_example.built_from: ward_evidence.csv row + build_ward_needs + equity/wards.csv + equity/monthly.csv; services/report_card.py over the delivery store (stops of the ward), the debt store and one stored plan (supplied before replay, latest day, approved before draft)
_example.notes: SYNTHETIC example: one registered stop in Ward 105 Gachibowli, a plan from 12 supplied bookings for 2026-10-03 approved, 3 deliveries (2 Confirmed, 1 Disputed), the day closed. See docs/api_additions/report_cards.md.

debt.basis: DERIVED (A6: litres the approved plan gave the ward's stops minus one load per Confirmed delivery, settled when an officer closes the day; bookings as supplied, not verified)

schedule.basis: Plan from 12 bookings supplied for the day, not the replay: bookings as supplied (not verified here); capacity ASSUMED (A8 fleet scenario main_2025, tight); need DERIVED from Census 2011
